ownerIdentityModel.origin: Verified Firebase Admin UID from session cookie or Authorization Bearer token (lib/server/productionIdentity/routeGuard.ts:9)
ownerIdentityModel.dbIdentity: owner_uid in workflow.asset_import_requests is 100% equivalent to authenticated Firebase UID
ownerIdentityModel.syntheticUidAssessment: staging_test_tiktok_<RUN_ID> is compatible with Postgres schema check constraints length(owner_uid) > 0, but incompatible with FK fk_asset_import_job_owner if job_id is populated, and incompatible with HTTP API route guards
ownerIdentityModel.saferAlternative: Embed RUN_ID strictly in idempotency_key (format: test_run_<RUN_ID>_<SEQ>), which allows authentic staging QA Firebase UIDs while strictly satisfying ck_asset_import_key regex ^[A-Za-z0-9._~-]{1,128}$

migrationRunner.packageJsonScripts: Only ephemeral docker test runners exist (test:postgresql-reconciliation-migration)
migrationRunner.liveCloudSqlRunner: None exists in repository; live migrations are strictly operator-managed via psql or external CI/CD
migrationRunner.preConnectionAuthorityValidation: Synchronous validation in lib/server/productionMediaRuntime/compositionCore.ts validates environment, WIF, GCS bucket, and Cloud SQL connection tuple before any network socket or pool is created

rollbackSafetyDesign.isolationMechanism: Atomic transaction with fail-closed audit asserting zero non-test TikTok rows and zero foreign key references
